heading: Friday, August 14, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Alibaba Qwen3.8-27B and Zhipu AI GLM-5.3.

items.headline: Alibaba releases open-weight Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B is an Apache-2.0 dense multimodal model with image and video understanding and 262K native context. Qwen reports 61.7 on SWE-bench Pro and 84.3 on OSWorld-Verified.

items.headline: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3 coding and cybersecurity model
items.summary: GLM-5.3 is a post-trained update on the GLM-5.2 base model, first offered through the GLM Coding Plan with weights released later under a custom GLM-5.3 license. Z.ai claims a 50% gain over GLM-5.2 on its in-house coding benchmark and 84.5% on CyberGym.
